podcasts.title: Signed, Sealed, Drained: Why Your Private Keys Aren’t What’s Getting Hacked with Raz Niv
podcasts.description: Every board member wants generative and agentic AI wired into enterprise products, but few are asking what happens to the plumbing underneath. In this episode, we dive into Cisco’s landmark AgenticOps study—surveying 1,000 enterprise IT and NetOps leaders—to uncover the infrastructure reality behind the hype. As AI workloads surge across clouds, devices, and applications, traditional networks are choking under an avalanche of traffic and alert noise; Cisco found the average enterprise alert backlog would take roughly 100 human engineers to clear manually. Enter AgenticOps: autonomous systems that detect, reason, and execute remediation at digital speed. A staggering 82% of leaders now trust AI to push production network changes without prior human sign-off, and over half run active agents in production today. Joe is here to unpack how NetOps has become the ultimate proving ground for autonomous operations. This isn't just a networking deep dive—it’s an early masterclass for every corporate function on how to run autonomous businesses when human-scale operations break down. Many more amazing technology episodes to come! Subscribe and prepare for the new world. If you would like to join the show, please reach out.
